name: Variable Leach
description:
About This Game

Story

As the mutant protagonist Leech, take on other rampaging mutants in intense, fast-paced combat.

Player Objective

  • Defeat all enemies in the stage.

  • Once you clear a stage, you decide which stage to proceed to next.

  • Defeat the boss in the final boss stage to complete the game.

Game Mechanics

  • Action

    • WASD Keys / Left Stick on Gamepad: Movement

    • Left Click / X Button on Gamepad: Standard Attack

    • Right Click / A Button on Gamepad: Evade, Counterattack

    • Shift Key + Left Click / Y Button on Gamepad: SP Attack

  • Stage Selection

    • WASD Keys / Left Stick on Gamepad: Movement

    • Space Bar / A Button on Gamepad: Selection

PlayTime

  • 2-5 minutes

Genre

  • Beautiful Women x Stylish Action x Roguelite

独自性

  • Enhance your abilities and conquer each stage with precision and flair.

  • Experience fluid, graceful motion and cinematic full-body action that blend exhilarating gameplay with effortless control.

Credit

  • Director/Producer

    Yuuki Hirai

  • CharacterDesign

    ユメムラサキ

  • Music

    zippy
short_desc: “Variable Leach” is a stylish 3D action game where a captivating woman dances through battle with elegance and power.
